Summary
The letter discusses the sender's involvement in moving their office to Victoria Park and expresses concern about the scarcity of writing material. The sender updates the recipients on the progress of the war, noting the better performance of the Pacific armies and the hope that they will reach Manila instead of Brisbane. The letter also mentions a raised Christmas card from the Fordham Library and expresses hope that the Philippines will be fully occupied soon, allowing the American Army to start a land assault on China. The sender remains in good health and expresses a desire to visit the Philippines.

--- Page 1 (Beckerman_06a) --- Dear Folks and Ruth 21 January 1945 Spent the day assisting in moving our office to Victoria Park. Sorry I haven't been writing as often as I should— subject matter is getting rather scant. War news is being closely with things looking better than ever. For one our armies in the Pacific are doing far better than the European army and every one over here is quite proud of our accomplishments. If things keep up as they are we'll all be in Manila instead of Brisbane. [illegible] of us. It's [illegible] --- Page 2 (Beckerman_06b) --- 3 Probably many more advances have been made. I've become very curious over the raised Christmas card I received recently from the "Fordham Library". When Ruth drops up there, wish she'd ask the librarian how my address was gotten. And also to thank them for the kind gesture: I enjoyed your tale of the misunder- stood souvenir and also Ruth's clipping of the City Triumph. That's about all for tonight. Am still in the best of health. and 2 relation. But everyone over here wants to go to the Philippines. It's a kind of goal every one's set for them- silver. And perhaps it won't be too long. I hope so. Once the Philippines are fully occupied, and become principally a supply and com- munication zone, then will be the time that the American Army will be able to start a land assault then China. The Red Army seems to have gotten the whole European affair into the last round. By the time you receive this letter, --- Page 3 (Beckerman_06c) --- getting along well in all [illegible] Love Jack
